description: The figure contains two pie charts labeled (a) and (b) that depict the proportional distribution of token categories (words/symbols) in each chart, with a legend above each pie mapping colors/patterns to labels and percentage values printed near the slices. Chart (a) shows 6 slices: “the” (blue with diagonal hatching) at about 31%, “this” (blue with horizontal stripes) at about 21%, “for” (green crosshatch) at about 17%, an unlabeled/blanked gray category (solid light gray) at about 15%, “to” (yellow with wavy hatching) at about 9%, and “in” (light blue with vertical stripes) at about 7%; the slices appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller around the circle, and none are exploded. Chart (b) shows 4 slices: “the” (blue with diagonal hatching) at about 38%, “$” (red with dotted/hatched texture) at about 27%, “equilibrium” (yellow with wavy hatching) at about 19%, and “consatant” (gray with dotted texture) at about 15%; percentages are labeled outside/near the slices, a legend is present above the pie, and no slice is visually offset or emphasized.
